[[File:CCS_TIE_proton_bomb.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A cross-section of a VL-61/79 proton bomb showing the internal parts of the weapon.]]

The '''VL-61/79 proton bomb''' was a [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] produced by [[ArmaTek/Legends|ArmaTek]] and used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These devices were usually employed by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]].<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
